sources.title: Synthetic evaluation fixture: planned trial
sources.abstract: This synthetic trial protocol plans to enroll 200 adults to compare intervention A with placebo. The primary outcome will be symptom score at 16 weeks. Recruitment has not begun and no results have been posted. Mortality is not a listed outcome.
